title: Keyboard focus indicator is moving twice on the upload a file control in windows.
body: ### Checklist - [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues. - [x] I added a very descriptive title to this issue. - [x] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue. ### Summary On the Streamlit Playground page, the file upload functionality exposes two consecutive keyboard focus stops—"Upload a File" and "Browse files"—even though both controls trigger the same file upload action. When keyboard users navigate through the interface, focus first lands on the non-essential "Upload a File" section and then moves to the "Browse files" button, resulting in redundant navigation for a single function. This behavior creates an unnecessary focus stop, making keyboard navigation less efficient and potentially causing confusion about which element should be activated. The file upload feature should provide a single keyboard-accessible focus target, with focus moving directly to the "Browse files" button. ### Reproducible Code Example ```Python ``` ### Steps To Reproduce 1. Open the URL: https://streamlit.io/playground?example=blank&code=H4sIAAAAAAAAA52QwUrEQAyG7_MUIV5aWBZWD8pCD8qyDyCIB5EydNI67LQzdFK2vfkOevfik_kEPoLpUF3BmyEwk-T7M5koZdvge4bIPenWWQYdJVAq8joSl0E3VFa-q22TpTtbdlTgzdDA5vzy6gJuKfQeV-D05Acu8GgNYZ4aJDY7sVvYDcHZSjPB3ldDBN_B3jqCu-C8NrNMncHH67P4koOdgC11HIHGoDtDPWRRtzQPeq_dQeLrRur5ovuHq6PlJ_n1-vuFDD_fXt7_TID5VoGYkLVMXQ6pLnjKzoaLRMMM4OqnwFOg4gGDqWVVaHw1zufo4oiPJ-pAU4G_WpebpYUs5gt5PhY6qwEAAA in edge/chrome browser. 2. Playground Streamlit page will appear. 3. Press tab key to reach to the 'Upload document' button and expand it. 4. Press tab key to reach to the 'Upload a file' and 'Browse files' buttons. 5. Verify whether keyboard focus indicator is moving twice on the upload a file control in windows or not. ### Expected Behavior The file upload feature should have only one keyboard-accessible focus stop. Keyboard focus shouldn't move to 'Upload a file' section, keyboard focus should only move to 'Browse File' button in windows. ### Current Behavior When navigating with the keyboard, focus lands first on the "Upload a File" section and then moves to the "Browse files" button. Since both controls perform the same action, users encounter two focus stops for a single file upload function. **Refer Attachment:** 1. Keyboard focus indicator is moving twice on the upload a file control in windows.png 2. Keyboard focus indicator is moving twice on the upload a file control in windows.mp4 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/975692ae-9027-4195-afa4-3b502b4b1cd8 ### Is this a regression? - [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version. ### Debug info - Streamlit version: 1.40.1 - Python version: 3.12.1 - OS: Windows 11 25H2 (OS Build 26200.8655) - Browsers: Edge (Version 150.0.4078.48), Chrome (Version 150.0.7871.115) - URL: https://streamlit.io/playground?example=blank&code=H4sIAAAAAAAAA52QwUrEQAyG7_MUIV5aWBZWD8pCD8qyDyCIB5EydNI67LQzdFK2vfkOevfik_kEPoLpUF3BmyEwk-T7M5koZdvge4bIPenWWQYdJVAq8joSl0E3VFa-q22TpTtbdlTgzdDA5vzy6gJuKfQeV-D05Acu8GgNYZ4aJDY7sVvYDcHZSjPB3ldDBN_B3jqCu-C8NrNMncHH67P4koOdgC11HIHGoDtDPWRRtzQPeq_dQeLrRur5ovuHq6PlJ_n1-vuFDD_fXt7_TID5VoGYkLVMXQ6pLnjKzoaLRMMM4OqnwFOg4gGDqWVVaHw1zufo4oiPJ-pAU4G_WpebpYUs5gt5PhY6qwEAAA ### Additional Information _No response_

### Reproduction Summary

**Confirmed** on Streamlit **1.59.1** (latest release) — this is not limited to the playground or the reporter's version (1.40.1).

**Observed behavior:** Tabbing through a `st.file_uploader` widget produces two consecutive focus stops:

1. The dropzone `<section>` container (`tabIndex=0`, `role="presentation"`)
2. The **Upload** button inside it (`<button>`, `tabIndex=0`)

Both elements open the same file picker dialog, so the first focus stop is redundant.

**Root cause:** The `FileDropzone` component spreads `{...getRootProps()}` from react-dropzone onto the dropzone `<section>`. react-dropzone assigns `tabIndex: 0` by default, and the Upload `<button>` inside is a native focusable element. Since neither `noKeyboard` nor `tabIndex: -1` is passed to `getRootProps()`, both elements appear in the tab order.

**Reproduction app:** https://issues.streamlit.app/?issue=gh-15921
